habit_scope: Three-coat Portland-cement stucco over mesh. CMHC Ch13. Alt to wood/vinyl siding, not the first-pass habit. Not EIFS.
how_it_is_done: Sheathing membrane lapped 100 mm (4 in) at the edges; all openings flashed; membrane around window flanges lapped so water does not enter (CMHC Ch13 Stucco). Tar-saturated felts/papers must not be used beneath stucco (bleed-through); tar-impregnated felts or paper may be used.
Keep ≥200 mm (8 in) above finished grade except over concrete/masonry — CANADIAN. Confirm AHJ.
High exposure: furred drained airspace ≥10 mm between stucco and membrane; top vented and baffled; bottom vented and flashed (CMHC). Not a Utah/Fontana habit unless AHJ.
Mesh stretched horizontally over sheathing paper, joints lapped ≥50 mm (2 in). External corners: mesh 150 mm (6 in) around, or vertical strips 150 mm (6 in) each side.

Galvanized steel fasteners: 3.2 mm (1/8 in) dia nails with ~11.1 mm (7/16 in) heads, OR 1.98 mm (0.078 in) thick staples. Spacing 150 mm (6 in) vertically and 400 mm (16 in) horizontally, OR 100 mm (4 in) vertically and 600 mm (24 in) horizontally. Other patterns OK if ≥20 fasteners per square meter (2 per square foot). Over plywood/OSB/lumber, fasteners into sheathing; over other sheathing, penetrate the framing ≥25 mm (1 in).

Scratch coat 6 mm (1/4 in) embedding the mesh, scored; up to 48 h cure. Dampen. Second coat ≥6 mm (1/4 in), moist-cure ≥48 h, dry ≥five days. Dampen. Finish ≥3 mm (1/8 in). Cold weather: each coat ≥10°C (50°F) for 48 h. Dry warm weather: keep damp.
tools_equipment: Named: trowel; mesh; galvanized fasteners. Not a SKU list.
inspection_hold_points: Mesh laps 2 in; corner returns 6 in.
Fastener count ≥2 per sf or the 6/16 or 4/24 patterns.
Scratch/brown/finish cure times (48 h / 48 h + 5 days).
typical_duration_sfr: unknown — cure times named, not a cycle
when_this_beats_habit: When the drawings call stucco. Not the first-touch wood/vinyl habit.
when_this_is_a_bad_idea: Tar-saturated felt under stucco. Skipping cure. Treating this as EIFS.
why_tier1_never_learned_it: Three coats and mesh schedule. Not the habit.
permit_gate: should be on drawings before permit
permit_gate_notes: CMHC Canadian. Confirm AHJ. Grade 8 in is Canadian.
risk_if_swapped_late: Siding to stucco after windows are in changes the membrane and mesh. Catch before permit.
plain_language_summary: Paper (not tar-saturated), mesh, three coats. Mesh nails 6 and 16 or 4 and 24, at least two per square foot. Wait the cures. This is an alt, not the wood-siding habit.
spanish_summary: Papel (no feltro alquitranado saturado), malla, tres capas. Clavos 6 y 16 o 4 y 24, minimo dos por pie cuadrado. Espere el curado. Alternativa, no el habito de siding.
